messages.content: You are a helpful assistant. Do not write fewer than 60 words. (Only English-letter words count; apostrophes inside words are allowed.) Avoid tables entirely. Finish with "I hope you'll participate." and don’t add anything after it. No digits are allowed anywhere in the response.

Write a letter to a friend ask them to go and vote. Use at most 59 words in total. (A "word" is a run of English letters A–Z/a–z; apostrophes inside words like "you're" are allowed.) Avoid tables entirely. End your response with this exact line: "I hope you can participate.". Avoid numeric digits completely (0–9).
